title.purpose: Section h2 (queue heads, board columns), colored by active queue hue.

lede.purpose: One-sentence editorial summary under every page head; strong text takes the fechar hue.

body.purpose: Running text and all monetary/numeric figures, tabular-nums.

label.purpose: Filter labels, table headers, uppercase action-panel captions.

shadows.name: ambient-md
shadows.purpose: Hover lift on buttons and cards; the deal masthead at rest.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover lift, color and background transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 5px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 0; transition: transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1), box-shadow 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(18,35,60,.06), 0 2px 8px rgba(18,35,60,.05); } .ds-btn-primary { background: #12233c; color: #f6f1e6; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(18,35,60,.10), 0 1px 3px rgba(18,35,60,.07); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #33517d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Gold Button
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 5px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 0; background: #b8873b; color: #211603; transition: transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1); } .ds-btn-gold:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action, inset ring instead of border.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 5px; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 0; background: #fffdf8; color: #1d2637; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #c8bda4; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #6a6152; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Queue Tag
components.description: Fixed queue label pill; one of four (fechar/decidir/avancar/prospectar).
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0.1rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a6212; background: #efe1bf; }

components.name: Score Badge
components.description: Circular percentile score, ring-tinted to the deal's queue hue.
components.html: 82
components.css: .ds-score { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 2.6rem; height: 2.6rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 800; border-radius: 50%; color: #8a6212; background: #efe1bf; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(138,98,18,0.22); }

components.name: Age Ruler
components.description: Signature three-zone SVG bar showing a deal's age against the observed sales-cycle distribution, with a navy position tick.
components.html: 42 dias
components.css: .ds-ruler { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 0.3rem; } .ds-ruler svg { width: 100%; height: 9px; display: block; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(29,38,55,0.08); } .ds-ruler-mark { position: absolute; top: -3px; width: 3px; height: 15px; margin-left: -1.5px; background: #12233c; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px #fffdf8; } .ds-ruler-label { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #6a6152; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Navy rail navigation link with a gold active tick.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: block; padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem; border-radius: 5px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: rgba(243,237,224,0.66); background: #12233c; transition: color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1), background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.25,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #f3ede0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); } .ds-nav-link-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 3px; height: 1.15rem; border-radius: 2px; background: #b8873b; }

narrative.overview:
A sales pipeline rendered as a G4-branded business broadsheet, not a SaaS dashboard. A deep-navy structural field (nav rail, table headers, the deal masthead) frames a warm ivory canvas; a serif editorial voice (Libre Caslon Text) carries headlines and one-sentence ledes, while Manrope carries UI chrome and tabular data. The system's single organizing idea is that color is the action queue, not decoration: the same four heraldic hues (gold/burgundy/sage/slate-navy) recur on every score badge, tag, table row-edge, board column and forecast stack so a deal's priority is legible at a glance across every screen it appears on. Gold is spent narrowly — the "Fechar" (close) queue, the brand compass-star, primary CTAs — so its appearance always means money or the one action to take.

The system supports a light theme (paper/navy/ink, the primary reading mode for daylight pipeline review) and a dark theme (navy-black inversion) via prefers-color-scheme with a manual data-theme="light" override; every color role is redefined per theme, never computed ad hoc.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy structural chrome against warm ivory paper — never a dark dashboard shell.
Four fixed heraldic queue hues (fechar=gold, decidir=burgundy, avancar=sage, prospectar=slate-navy) as the app's only categorical color system.
Libre Caslon Text serif for all headings and editorial ledes; Manrope sans for every UI control and tabular figure.
Flat-to-lightly-lifted surfaces: thin warm hairlines and soft ambient shadows, no hard offset shadows.
A recurring hand-drawn age-ruler SVG as the signature data component.

rules.name: The Color-Is-Queue Rule
rules.body: The four heraldic hues (gold/burgundy/sage/slate-navy) are the app's only categorical color system and mean exactly one thing each — fechar/decidir/avancar/prospectar — wherever they appear (score ring, tag, table row-edge, board column border, forecast stack, ruler zone). Never introduce a fifth categorical color or reuse one of the four for an unrelated meaning.

rules.name: The Gold-Is-Money Rule
rules.body: Signature gold appears only on the brand mark, the Fechar queue, and primary-action fills. It never decorates a neutral element.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Caslon is reserved for headlines, ledes and quote/italic voice; Manrope carries every other UI surface including all tabular and numeric data. No third display face, no system UI font substitution for either role.

rules.name: The Soft-Lift Rule
rules.body: Depth is ambient and directional-light soft, never a hard offset block shadow. Hover states raise translateY(-1px/-2px) paired with the medium shadow step; nothing snaps to a harsh silhouette.

dos: Do keep gold spent only on the Fechar queue, the brand mark, and primary CTAs (The Gold-Is-Money Rule).
Do pair Caslon headlines/ledes with Manrope for every control and number (The Two-Voice Rule).
Do draw icons and marks (age-ruler, sort indicators, back chevron, reason markers, the compass-star) as inline SVG in one consistent stroke weight — never a unicode glyph or icon font.
Do keep depth ambient and soft (The Soft-Lift Rule); reserve shadow escalation for hover/interactive state, not resting decoration.
Do carry the four heraldic queue hues identically across every surface a deal's status appears on (score, tag, row edge, board column, stack, ruler zone).
donts: Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label floating above a page or section heading; the built system folds context (like a dateline) into the lede's own prose sentence instead. This is a defect the finish review removed from one page, not a pattern to reintroduce.
Don't introduce a fifth categorical color, or reuse a queue hue for a meaning outside its queue.
Don't use hard-edged offset shadows (neobrutalist block shadows); this world's depth is ambient-soft only.
Don't substitute a system display face for Libre Caslon Text in headline/lede roles, or a system sans for Manrope in UI/data roles.
